{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and converted orders
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_sum = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_sum / n_loyal

# Print only the conversion rate as a float
print(conversion_rate)"}
